name: Camping Maria
beschreibung: This entry describes a campsite called Camping Maria in the Ötztal valley near the village of Längenfeld in Tyrol. It mentions sanitary facilities, electrical hookups, a small shop, and a restaurant serving regional cuisine, as well as a season from May to October. In the specified region, no business of this name could be clearly verified during the check. The Ötztal is a side valley of the Inn in the Imst district and an established tourist region in Tyrol; the municipality of Längenfeld in the front Ötztal is known among other things for the Tyrol Therme AQUA DOME and numerous hiking opportunities in the surrounding mountain world.
